title: The bottleneck might be the air in the room
description: You gather your most expensive people into a room to make your most important decisions. Then, somewhere in the second hour, the room quietly gets worse at making them. Not the people. The room.
note: I usually have a low social battery, but this is an eye-opener. This not only applies to meeting rooms, but extremely closed spaces like cars too. Hidden right under our noses, literally!
